latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Image to Video 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly converts uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into YouTube-ready videos with music and transitions, no editing software needed.
- Automatic token and session management for fast setup and free starter credits.
- Streamlined workflows: upload photos, describe your video, and receive a 1080p MP4 download in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports file uploads up to 200MB and seamless preview, export, and credit check commands.
- Responsive backend handles edits, state queries, and error codes with clear chat feedback.
